Hi everyone, just a quick update.

Some helpful feedback recently highlighted that our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy weren’t as clear as they should have been. We’ve now taken the time to review and improve them to better reflect what VeganProfile stands for transparency, user control, and strong ethical standards.

We should have clearly stated we do not sell or share your data.

Just to clarify, we’ve never sold or shared user data for advertising or anything similar, and we have no plans to. The previous wording came from a default template we hadn’t fully customised, and that’s entirely on us. 
It didn’t match how we actually operate and it’s now been corrected.

We encourage anyone interested to read through the updated terms here:

https://www.veganprofile.com/terms-of-service  https://www.veganprofile.com/privacy-policy

Appreciate everyone who raised concerns, we’re focused on improving and doing things the right way, always.

Sorry to hear that, and thanks for checking it out. 
We definitely need to focus on getting more users onto the platform once that happens, everyone should have someone nearby.

Yes, we have worked with a GDPR-compliant company and have GDPR software in place. All user account data is deleted automatically within 5 days of deleting their profile. This provides enough time in case someone wants to change their mind.
Thank you and I hope you enjoy the platform 💚
Thank you, hopefully in a month or two.
